component.name: Signpost
component.summary: Choose which browser opens each link

description.p: Signpost is a link chooser for the COSMIC™ desktop. Make it your default handler for web links, and every link you open from any app shows a small picker of your browsers, each browser profile, and the other apps that can open it. Pick one and the link opens there.

ul.li: Every profile of Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, Helium, Firefox, LibreWolf, Zen and Floorp as a tile of its own
Number keys, arrows and Enter pick without the mouse; Ctrl+Enter keeps the picker open
Private windows and each app's actions from a tile's menu
Links that arrive while the picker is open wait their turn
Your previous browser is recorded and can be restored with one button
Follows the COSMIC theme, including frosted windows
